# Current curator backend certificate

`permission-set-full.json` is copied byte for byte from
`curator-backend/test/fixtures/api/merkle/permission-set-full.json`.

Generated by actual Docker-backed `pnpm merkle:api-fixtures` at backend HEAD `d2b2121575dbfc8f1a61bc30084e9fbaf43de233`.
The input omits the removed adapter push leaf.

SHA256: `9b5597b84961b256d05caa4ff62725e9276cd3b5e012ecd2eff3a8b4a6dba89c`.

It contains the actual GET certificate envelope, opaque frontend metadata
and 77 executable calls. The source test validates all call hashes and proofs
against the active root independently of the certificate.
